proposals.title: Our Commitment to a Business Standards Review and Report
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia and other co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requested a comprehensive report on root causes of fraudulent activities, plans to address them, progress measures and disclosure; proposal was withdrawn after company agreed to a business standards review.
proposals.evidence: the Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia and other co-filers withdrew their proposal

proposals.title: Special Shareowner Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Reform Executive Compensation Policy with Social Responsibility
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to engage multiple outside independent experts to reform executive compensation policy with social responsibility.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.title: Report on Incentive Compensation and Risks of Material Losses
proposals.proponent: The Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether employees eligible for incentive pay tied to metrics that could expose the company to material losses, with breakdowns of such compensation.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal
